steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Rearrange to $3x^2-30x+74=0$; the discriminant is $(-30)^2-4(3)(74)=12$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The quadratic formula gives $x=(30\pm\sqrt{12})/6=5\pm\sqrt3/3$; both satisfy $3(x-5)^2=1$.

exercises.prompt: 求 $(\sqrt t+1)^2+2(\sqrt t+1)=3$ 的所有实数解。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 先要求 $t\ge0$。令 $u=\sqrt t+1\ge1$，方程变为 $u^2+2u-3=(u+3)(u-1)=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $u=-3$ 不满足 $u\ge1$；$u=1$ 给 $\sqrt t=0$，所以 $t=0$。原式左边为 $1+2=3$。

en.prompt: Find all real solutions of $(\sqrt t+1)^2+2(\sqrt t+1)=3$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Require $t\ge0$. Let $u=\sqrt t+1\ge1$; then $u^2+2u-3=(u+3)(u-1)=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $u=-3$ violates $u\ge1$; $u=1$ gives $\sqrt t=0$, hence $t=0$. The original left side is $1+2=3$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分母零点2必须排除；分子零点4因严格大于也不取。分成 $(-\infty,2),(2,4),(4,\infty)$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分别取 $x=0,3,5$，商的符号依次为负、正、负。只有中间区间满足。

en.prompt: Solve $\frac{4-x}{2x-4}>0$ and give the solution in interval notation.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Exclude denominator zero 2 and, for the strict inequality, numerator zero 4. Split into $(-\infty,2),(2,4),(4,\infty)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Testing $x=0,3,5$ gives signs negative, positive, negative. Only the middle interval satisfies the inequality.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 所以 $y=-2x/3+1$；代入 $x=-6$ 得5，核对另一点。

en.prompt: Write the slope–intercept equation of the line through $(3,-1)$ and $(-6,5)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Thus $y=-2x/3+1$; substituting $x=-6$ gives 5, verifying the other point.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 对数真数须严格为正：$x/(2-x)>0$，且 $x\ne2$。临界点为0和2。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 在 $x<0$ 商负；$0<x<2$ 商正；$x>2$ 商负。两个端点均排除。

en.prompt: Find the domain of $f(x)=\ln\left(\frac{x}{2-x}\right)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The logarithm argument must be positive: $x/(2-x)>0$, with $x\ne2$. Critical points are 0 and 2.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The quotient is negative for $x<0$, positive for $0<x<2$, and negative for $x>2$. Exclude both endpoints.

exercises.prompt: 指出基本函数并用变换画 $f(x)=2(x-3)^2-5$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 从 $y=x^2$ 开始，右移3，竖直伸长2倍，再下移5。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 顶点 $(3,-5)$，对称轴 $x=3$，开口向上；$y$ 截距13。令函数为0得 $x=3\pm\sqrt{10}/2$，值域 $[-5,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Identify the basic function and use transformations to sketch $f(x)=2(x-3)^2-5$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Start with $y=x^2$: shift right 3, stretch vertically by 2, then shift down 5.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The vertex is $(3,-5)$, axis $x=3$, and it opens upward. The $y$-intercept is 13; zeros are $x=3\pm\sqrt{10}/2$ and the range is $[-5,\infty)$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 从 $e^x$ 竖直伸长4倍，再上移1。水平渐近线由0上移到 $y=1$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 过 $(0,5)$，始终递增；定义域 $\mathbb R$，值域 $(1,\infty)$；无 $x$ 截距。

en.prompt: Use transformations to sketch $f(x)=4e^x+1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Stretch $e^x$ vertically by 4, then shift up 1. The horizontal asymptote moves from 0 to $y=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The graph passes through $(0,5)$ and is strictly increasing; domain $\mathbb R$, range $(1,\infty)$, and no $x$-intercept.

exercises.prompt: 若 $f(x)=\ln x,g(x)=-1/x$，求 $(f\circ g)(x)$ 的定义域，用区间表示。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 复合为 $\ln(-1/x)$，先要求 $x\ne0$，再要求 $-1/x>0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子为负，故分母也须负，得 $x<0$。

en.prompt: Find the domain of $(f\circ g)(x)$ in interval notation if $f(x)=\ln x$ and $g(x)=-1/x$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The composition is $\ln(-1/x)$. Require $x\ne0$ and then $-1/x>0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The numerator is negative, so the denominator must also be negative: $x<0$.

exercises.prompt: 判断是否有反函数，若有求出：(a) $f(x)=3x+7$；(b) $f(x)=|x|$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 非零斜率保证一一对应。交换 $x,y$ 后 $x=3y+7$，所以 $y=(x-7)/3$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) $f(1)=f(-1)=1$，不是一一函数；在全体实数定义域上没有反函数。

en.prompt: Determine whether each function has an inverse; if so, find it. (a) $f(x)=3x+7$, (b) $f(x)=|x|$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) A nonzero slope makes the function one-to-one. Interchanging $x,y$ gives $x=3y+7$, hence $y=(x-7)/3$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) $f(1)=f(-1)=1$, so it is not one-to-one and has no inverse on its full real domain.

exercises.prompt: 用综合除法求 $\frac{2x^4+4x^3+x^2+x-2}{x+2}$ 的商和余数。

en.prompt: Use synthetic division to find the quotient and remainder of $\frac{2x^4+4x^3+x^2+x-2}{x+2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use root $-2$ and coefficients $2,4,1,1,-2$. Bring down 2; multiply by -2 to get -4, and add 4 to get 0.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Continue to obtain bottom row $2,0,1,-1,0$, giving quotient $2x^3+x-1$ and remainder 0.

exercises.prompt: 求 $f(x)=\frac{10-3x^2}{x^2+4x-5}$ 的水平和竖直渐近线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分母 $x^2+4x-5=(x+5)(x-1)$，分子在 $-5,1$ 均非零，故两处均为竖直渐近线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 分子分母同次，水平渐近线等于首项系数比 $y=-3/1=-3$。

en.prompt: Find the horizontal and vertical asymptotes of $f(x)=\frac{10-3x^2}{x^2+4x-5}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The denominator is $(x+5)(x-1)$; the numerator is nonzero at -5 and 1, so both give vertical asymptotes.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Equal degrees give horizontal asymptote equal to the leading-coefficient ratio: $y=-3$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 取幂、商和乘积法则，得到 $\frac23\log|x|+\frac13\log|y|-\frac13\log|z|$。原定义域为 $x\ne0,y/z>0$；教材常用正变量假设下可去掉绝对值。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 原式要求 $y>0,x\ne0$；展开为 $\ln7-\ln5+4\ln|x|-\frac12\ln y$。

en.prompt: Expand using logarithm rules: (a) $\log\sqrt[3]{x^2y/z}$, (b) $\ln\left(\frac{7x^4}{5\sqrt y}\right)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Apply power, quotient, and product rules to get $\frac23\log|x|+\frac13\log|y|-\frac13\log|z|$. The original domain is $x\ne0,y/z>0$; under the usual positive-variable assumption, omit absolute values.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The original expression requires $y>0,x\ne0$. Expansion gives $\ln7-\ln5+4\ln|x|-\frac12\ln y$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 右支是 $\ln x$ 关于 $x$ 轴的反射，过 $(1,0)$，靠近 $0^+$ 趋于正无穷，$x\to\infty$ 时趋于负无穷。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 左支为 $\ln(-x)$，过 $(-1,0)$，$x\to0^-$ 时趋于负无穷，$x\to-\infty$ 时趋于正无穷。两支关于原点对称，$x=0$ 无定义且为竖直渐近线。

exercises.answer: 定义域 $x\ne0$；两支过 $(\pm1,0)$；竖直渐近线 $x=0$。

en.prompt: Sketch $f(x)=-\ln x$ for $x>0$ and $f(x)=\ln|x|$ for $x<0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The right branch reflects $\ln x$ across the $x$-axis; it passes through $(1,0)$, tends to $+\infty$ as $x\to0^+$, and to $-\infty$ as $x\to\infty$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The left branch is $\ln(-x)$ through $(-1,0)$; it tends to $-\infty$ as $x\to0^-$ and to $+\infty$ as $x\to-\infty$. The branches have origin symmetry; $x=0$ is excluded and is a vertical asymptote.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 这里 $\log$ 表示以10为底；指数形式为 $x^2+9x=10$。

en.prompt: Solve $\log(x^2+9x)=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Here $\log$ is base 10; exponential form gives $x^2+9x=10$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Factor $x^2+9x-10=(x+10)(x-1)=0$, so $x=-10,1$. Both give original logarithm argument 10 and are valid.

exercises.prompt: 列出 $f(x)=2x^4+5x^3+x^2+10x-6$ 所有可能的有理零点。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 有理零点 $p/q$（既约）满足 $p$ 整除常数项6、$q$ 整除首项系数2。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 列举并去重：$\pm1,\pm2,\pm3,\pm6,\pm1/2,\pm3/2$。这些是候选，不表示每个都是实际零点。

en.prompt: Find all possible rational zeros of $f(x)=2x^4+5x^3+x^2+10x-6$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: A reduced rational zero $p/q$ has $p$ dividing 6 and $q$ dividing 2.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: List and deduplicate: $\pm1,\pm2,\pm3,\pm6,\pm1/2,\pm3/2$. These are candidates, not necessarily actual zeros.

exercises.prompt: 求其他五个三角函数值：(a) $\cos\theta=\frac{3}{7}$，锐角。 (b) $\sin\theta=\frac{2}{11}$，锐角。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 取终边上的点 $(3,2 \sqrt{10})$，由勾股定理 $r=\sqrt{49}=7$。符号由所在象限确定。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 代入定义 $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$，再求倒数并有理化：$\sin\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{10}}{7}$；$\tan\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{10}}{3}$；$\csc\theta=\frac{7 \sqrt{10}}{20}$；$\sec\theta=\frac{7}{3}$；$\cot\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{10}}{20}$

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 取终边上的点 $(3 \sqrt{13},2)$，由勾股定理 $r=\sqrt{121}=11$。符号由所在象限确定。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 代入定义 $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$，再求倒数并有理化：$\cos\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{13}}{11}$；$\tan\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{13}}{39}$；$\csc\theta=\frac{11}{2}$；$\sec\theta=\frac{11 \sqrt{13}}{39}$；$\cot\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{13}}{2}$

en.prompt: Find the five remaining trigonometric values: (a) $\cos\theta=\frac{3}{7}$, acute. (b) $\sin\theta=\frac{2}{11}$, acute.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Use the terminal-side point $(3,2 \sqrt{10})$. The Pythagorean theorem gives $r=\sqrt{(3)^2+(2 \sqrt{10})^2}=7$; the quadrant sets the signs.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Apply $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$, then take reciprocals and rationalize: $\sin\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{10}}{7}$; $\tan\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{10}}{3}$; $\csc\theta=\frac{7 \sqrt{10}}{20}$; $\sec\theta=\frac{7}{3}$; $\cot\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{10}}{20}$

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Use the terminal-side point $(3 \sqrt{13},2)$. The Pythagorean theorem gives $r=\sqrt{(3 \sqrt{13})^2+(2)^2}=11$; the quadrant sets the signs.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Apply $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$, then take reciprocals and rationalize: $\cos\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{13}}{11}$; $\tan\theta=\frac{2 \sqrt{13}}{39}$; $\csc\theta=\frac{11}{2}$; $\sec\theta=\frac{11 \sqrt{13}}{39}$; $\cot\theta=\frac{3 \sqrt{13}}{2}$

exercises.prompt: 求其他五个三角函数值：(a) $\cos\theta=- \frac{4}{5}$，第II象限。 (b) $\cot\theta=\frac{5}{12}$，第III象限。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 取终边上的点 $(-4,3)$，由勾股定理 $r=\sqrt{25}=5$。符号由所在象限确定。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 代入定义 $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$，再求倒数并有理化：$\sin\theta=\frac{3}{5}$；$\tan\theta=- \frac{3}{4}$；$\csc\theta=\frac{5}{3}$；$\sec\theta=- \frac{5}{4}$；$\cot\theta=- \frac{4}{3}$

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 取终边上的点 $(-5,-12)$，由勾股定理 $r=\sqrt{169}=13$。符号由所在象限确定。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 代入定义 $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$，再求倒数并有理化：$\sin\theta=- \frac{12}{13}$；$\cos\theta=- \frac{5}{13}$；$\tan\theta=\frac{12}{5}$；$\csc\theta=- \frac{13}{12}$；$\sec\theta=- \frac{13}{5}$

en.prompt: Find the five remaining trigonometric values: (a) $\cos\theta=- \frac{4}{5}$, quadrant II. (b) $\cot\theta=\frac{5}{12}$, quadrant III.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Use the terminal-side point $(-4,3)$. The Pythagorean theorem gives $r=\sqrt{(-4)^2+(3)^2}=5$; the quadrant sets the signs.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Apply $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$, then take reciprocals and rationalize: $\sin\theta=\frac{3}{5}$; $\tan\theta=- \frac{3}{4}$; $\csc\theta=\frac{5}{3}$; $\sec\theta=- \frac{5}{4}$; $\cot\theta=- \frac{4}{3}$

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Use the terminal-side point $(-5,-12)$. The Pythagorean theorem gives $r=\sqrt{(-5)^2+(-12)^2}=13$; the quadrant sets the signs.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Apply $\sin\theta=y/r,\cos\theta=x/r,\tan\theta=y/x$, then take reciprocals and rationalize: $\sin\theta=- \frac{12}{13}$; $\cos\theta=- \frac{5}{13}$; $\tan\theta=\frac{12}{5}$; $\csc\theta=- \frac{13}{12}$; $\sec\theta=- \frac{13}{5}$

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 因式分解角度成 $1(x-(- \pi))$；振幅 $|a|=\frac{1}{2}$，周期 $T=2 \pi$，相移 $- \pi$，中线 $y=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 用平滑正弦曲线连接这些点，按周期重复。定义域为全体实数，值域为 $[- \frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}]$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 因式分解角度成 $1(x-(- \frac{5 \pi}{3}))$；振幅 $|a|=5$，周期 $T=2 \pi$，相移 $- \frac{5 \pi}{3}$，中线 $y=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 用平滑正弦曲线连接这些点，按周期重复。定义域为全体实数，值域为 $[-5,5]$。

en.prompt: Sketch over $[-2\pi,2\pi]$: (a) $y=-\frac{1}{2}\cos(x+\pi)$, (b) $y=-5\sin(x+5\pi/3)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Factor the argument as $1(x-(- \pi))$. The amplitude is $\frac{1}{2}$, period $T=2 \pi$, phase shift $- \pi$, and midline $y=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Divide one period into four equal parts and evaluate: $(- \pi,- \frac{1}{2})$, $(- \frac{\pi}{2},0)$, $(0,\frac{1}{2})$, $(\frac{\pi}{2},0)$, $(\pi,- \frac{1}{2})$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Join the points with a smooth sinusoidal curve and repeat periodically. The domain is all real numbers; the range is $[- \frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Factor the argument as $1(x-(- \frac{5 \pi}{3}))$. The amplitude is $5$, period $T=2 \pi$, phase shift $- \frac{5 \pi}{3}$, and midline $y=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Divide one period into four equal parts and evaluate: $(- \frac{5 \pi}{3},0)$, $(- \frac{7 \pi}{6},-5)$, $(- \frac{2 \pi}{3},0)$, $(- \frac{\pi}{6},5)$, $(\frac{\pi}{3},0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Join the points with a smooth sinusoidal curve and repeat periodically. The domain is all real numbers; the range is $[-5,5]$.

en.answer: (a) Amplitude $\frac{1}{2}$; period $2 \pi$; phase shift $- \pi$; range $[- \frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}]$. (b) Amplitude $5$; period $2 \pi$; phase shift $- \frac{5 \pi}{3}$; range $[-5,5]$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 主值在第四象限，$\cos\theta=+\sqrt{1-1/25}=2\sqrt6/5$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 主值在第一象限，取邻边2、对边7、斜边 $\sqrt{53}$，得到 $7/\sqrt{53}=7\sqrt{53}/53$。

en.prompt: Find the exact value or state undefined: (a) $y=\cos[\sin^{-1}(-1/5)]$, (b) $y=\sin[\tan^{-1}(7/2)]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) The principal angle is in quadrant IV, so $\cos\theta=+\sqrt{1-1/25}=2\sqrt6/5$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) The principal angle is in quadrant I. Adjacent side 2, opposite side 7, and hypotenuse $\sqrt{53}$ give $7/\sqrt{53}=7\sqrt{53}/53$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 先算 $\cos(5\pi/3)=1/2$；在反余弦主值区间 $[0,\pi]$ 内，余弦为 $1/2$ 的角是 $\pi/3$。

en.prompt: Find the exact value of $y=\cos^{-1}[\cos(5\pi/3)]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: First, $\cos(5\pi/3)=1/2$. The angle with cosine $1/2$ in the arccosine range $[0,\pi]$ is $\pi/3$.
